convert_deepseek_vl_weights: convert DeepSeek-VL model weights from original DeepSeek format to HuggingFace transformers format
convert_old_keys_to_new_keys: convert old model state dict keys to new HuggingFace key names using regex pattern mapping
update_state_dict: update a model state dict by splitting QKV weights, squeezing pos_embed dimensions, and renaming keys
load_model_state_dict: load a model state dict from safetensors files, handling both single-file and sharded model layouts
convert_model: convert a DeepSeek-VL model from original weights to HuggingFace format and save locally or push to the hub
